meta.description: Q-fusion: two-neuron calibration (analytic vs simulated, SPEC example), and N=40 neuron networks swept in b from W=0 (cold) and by continuation up/down, with cluster count, diameters, fixed-point identity checks, nestedness and hysteresis.

config.pair: two neurons, A = I (deg 1), bank = 4 rows (+-1,+-1) * sqrt(D0^2/2) so C_hat = sigma2*I exactly

fields.pair.spec_example: SPEC example (b=.2, alpha=.1) for D0^2 = 2 (unit-variance inputs) and 1; fixed_points [w, stable]; sims from w0 in {0,.5,3}
fields.pair.grid.rows: [D0^2, alpha, b, #stable analytic fixed points, w end from 0, w end from b/alpha, max residual] (w in conductance units, same as deg)
fields.pair.phase: analytic bistability window: b_sn(alpha) < b < b_on = D0^2/2 (b in D^2 units), non-empty iff D0^2/2 > alpha/4
fields.pair.loop: continuation in b (step grid_step) up then down; w_up/w_down end states; switch points vs analytic b_on and b_sn
fields.runs[].cold|up|down.<field>[k]: value at b_grid[k]; cold = from W=0, up/down = continuation carrying W
fields.K: number of connected components of the live graph (w > 1e-9), singletons included
fields.diam_max: max over components of max RMS distance D of a member to the prototype (response units, training bank)
fields.diam_mean: mean over multi-member components of the mean member-to-prototype D (training bank)
fields.span_max: max pairwise D inside any component (training bank)
fields.span_over_range: span_max / sqrt(2b): > 1 means a component is wider than one edge's range (a chain)
fields.diam_max_eval: diam_max recomputed on the evaluation bank (sampling check)
fields.span_over_range_eval: span_over_range with D from the evaluation bank (independent population geometry)
fields.d2_sampling: max |D2_train - D2_eval| / max D2_eval over pairs (sampling error)
fields.dev_live: max over live edges |alpha w - (b - D^2/2)| (fixed-point identity error, D^2 units)
fields.slack_dead: min over dead pairs of D^2 - 2b (>= -residual expected)
fields.residual: projected residual max|dw/dt| at the end
fields.J: J(W) = mean energy over the training bank + sum_{i<j} (alpha/2 w^2 - b w)
fields.nest_cold: pair_violation(lab at b_k, lab at b_{k+1}) for cold runs: fraction of pairs together at the smaller b but apart at the larger b (0 = nested refinement)
fields.part_diff_up_down: pair_violation(up,down)+pair_violation(down,up) at each b (0 = same partition, no hysteresis)
fields.envelope_err: max |central-difference dE*/dw - D^2/2| on 2 live + 2 dead pairs at the mid-grid cold fixed point

meta.seed_streams: network attachments [seed,0]; thresholds [seed,3]; training bank [seed,1]; evaluation bank [seed,2]; random covariance presets fixed seed 12345
